name: Super Lemon Haze Cartridge | 1g
description: This sativa-dominant hybrid of Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze may be found covered in kief and coloring. With it’s lemon characteristics the consumer will be left with a zesty lemon, sweet and citrus aftertaste. Not to be confused with a sour candy, this strain is a powerful balance of sweet and tart lemon delight.
